title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00144 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 06:30: WOC meanwhile continued working on TDS, aligned saver sub. changed hydraulic hose on TDS retract system inspected saver sub prepared and measured upcoming bhas bled off b-annulus. 2 bar trapped, bled off all pressure performed PMS performed housekeeping at WH deck
06:30 - 07:00: P/u 1 5 1/2" DP stand and RIH w/ tubing from 2508 m to 2549 m. M/u TDS to DP.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for tagging TOC and leave tubing in well.
07:15 - 08:15: Initiated flow 550 LPM 10 bar. Washed down slowly to 2620 mmd and attempted to tag TOC. Took weight gradually, 8 ton, indicating green cement.
08:15 - 09:00: POOH to 2600 mmd. Circulated 500 LPM 10 bar.
09:00 - 09:45: POOH to 2587 mmd while circulating 500 LPM 10 bar. Increased flow to 1500 LPM 63 bar, circulated b/u while discharging cement contaminated returns.
09:45 - 11:30: WOC while circulating at 500 LPM 10 bar.
11:30 - 12:00: Washed down slowly with 550 LPM 10 bar. Observed pressure slighly increasing to 15 bar. Reduced flow rate to 200 LPM 2 bar. Tagged TOC with 10 ton at 2621 mmd. Set down all tubing weight and disengaged spear.
12:00 - 12:15: B/o TDS dropped 3" drift.
12:15 - 13:00: POOH w/ spear BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 362 m to 15 m. Avg. Tripping speed 600 m/hr.
13:00 - 13:30: L/d single 5 1/2" DP. R/b spear BHA.
13:30 - 13:45: P/u and m/u jet sub.
13:45 - 14:00: RIH w/ jet sub on 5 1/2" DP to 23 m.
14:00 - 14:10: Cleaned MS-T seal assy surface with 1500 LPM 22 bar. Made 3 x passes.
14:10 - 14:20: POOH w/ jet sub on 5 1/2" DP from 23 m to surface.
14:20 - 14:30: L/d jet sub.
14:30 - 14:45: P/u and m/u MS-T seal retrieval tool.
14:45 - 15:30: R/u control lines to MS-T retrieval tool. Function tested retrieval tool.
15:30 - 16:45: RIH with MS-T retrieval tool to 20 m. Set down 2 ton. M/u TDS engaged tool, managed to achieve 2,5 turns left. Ran hydraulic sequence to release MS-T seal.
16:45 - 17:00: Pulled MS-T seal free with 70 ton OP.
17:00 - 17:15: POOH with MS-T retrieval tool and seal

sections.text: WOC meanwhile continued working on TDS, aligned saver sub. changed hydraulic hose on TDS retract system inspected saver sub prepared and measured upcoming bhas bled off b-annulus. 2 bar trapped, bled off all pressure performed PMS performed housekeeping at WH deck
P/u 1 5 1/2" DP stand and RIH w/ tubing from 2508 m to 2549 m. M/u TDS to DP.
Performed TBT for tagging TOC and leave tubing in well.
Initiated flow 550 LPM 10 bar. Washed down slowly to 2620 mmd and attempted to tag TOC. Took weight gradually, 8 ton, indicating green cement.
POOH to 2600 mmd. Circulated 500 LPM 10 bar.
POOH to 2587 mmd while circulating 500 LPM 10 bar. Increased flow to 1500 LPM 63 bar, circulated b/u while discharging cement contaminated returns.
WOC while circulating at 500 LPM 10 bar.

Washed down slowly with 550 LPM 10 bar. Observed pressure slighly increasing to 15 bar. Reduced flow rate to 200 LPM 2 bar. Tagged TOC with 10 ton at 2621 mmd. Set down all tubing weight and disengaged spear.
B/o TDS dropped 3" drift.
POOH w/ spear BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 362 m to 15 m. Avg. Tripping speed 600 m/hr.
L/d single 5 1/2" DP. R/b spear BHA.
P/u and m/u jet sub.
RIH w/ jet sub on 5 1/2" DP to 23 m.
Cleaned MS-T seal assy surface with 1500 LPM 22 bar. Made 3 x passes.
POOH w/ jet sub on 5 1/2" DP from 23 m to surface.
L/d jet sub.
P/u and m/u MS-T seal retrieval tool.
R/u control lines to MS-T retrieval tool. Function tested retrieval tool.
RIH with MS-T retrieval tool to 20 m. Set down 2 ton. M/u TDS engaged tool, managed to achieve 2,5 turns left. Ran hydraulic sequence to release MS-T seal.
Pulled MS-T seal free with 70 ton OP.
POOH with MS-T retrieval tool and seal assy to surface.
R/d control lines from MS-T retrieval tool. L/d retrieval tool.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor
P/u and m/u cutter BHA for cutting 10 3/4" surface tie-back.
RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 9 m to 117 m.

Established parameters 200 LPM 7 bar, 400 LPM 48 bar, 500 LPM 81 bar, 600 LPM 116 bar. 40 RPM 2 to 4 KNM, 80 RPM 2 to 5 KNM, 100 RPM 2 to 6 KNM. Up/down weight 72/68 ton. Positioned cutter at 123 m and cut 10 3/4" tie-back casing, 100 RPM 3 to 8 KNM, 400 LPM 49 bar. Observed pressure drop, indicating casing cut.
Pulled up while circulating at 500 LPM, observed pressure increasing to 111 bar. Ran in slowly with rotation, observed pressure dropped to 3 bar when knifes entered cut.
POOH w/ 10 3/4" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 123 m to surface.
L/d cutter BHA to HTS.
P/u and m/u spear BHA from set-back. Inspected grapple.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" spear BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 25 m. Engaged spear and attempted to pull 10 3/4" surface tie-back casing, 30 ton OP.
Disengaged spear and POOH to surface. R/b spear BHA.
P/u 10 3/4" cutter BHA from HTS. Adjusted sweep and physical stop on cutters.
RIH w/ 10 3/4" BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 123 m. M/u TDS

Initiated rotation and flow, 100 RPM 2 to 6 KNM, 500 LPM 81 bar. Cut 10 3/4" surface tie-back casing. Observed slight knock in riser and pressure dropped, indicating successful cut. Observed mud like substance on shaker, switched on gas trap. No gas observed.
Flowchecked well for 10 min prior to POOH, static.
B/o TDS. POOH w/ 10 3/4" cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 123 m to surface.
L/d cutter BHA
Reset and calibrated spinner wrench on IRN.
